thread_text:
Elena V: Need a concise launch kit for SecureServe aimed at enterprise buyers. Deliverables: 1) 1-page CISO exec summary, 2) 1-page field engineer quickstart/checklist, 3) 90s benchmark script for SDRs, 4) short webinar run of show. Who owns what?
Noah L: I can draft the CISO one-pager + CTAs. Keep it focused: security posture, SLA tiers, deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), and a single ROI bullet.
Priya M: I'll take the field-facing checklist. Want it to be actionable: network requirements, IAM/KMS notes, sample config snippets, and a tiny routing play for inbound leads.
Sam T: Benchmark numbers for the 90s pitch: median latency 45ms, P99 ~90ms on short-chat profile (hosted), private-dedicated pool show ~70ms P99 with steady throughput at 150 req/s; batching gives ~28% token cost reduction. Use conservative language (example values).
Elena V: Good. For the 90s SDR script we want: problem statement (regulated apps need predictable latency + SLAs), what SecureServe provides (SLA options, private deployments, cost controls), and one concrete stat. Keep it tight.
Noah L: Draft SDR script snippet: "In ~90s: SecureServe lets product teams serve LLMs with enterprise-grade controls—choose SLA-backed Dedicated or isolated Private deployments, get predictable latency (P99 ~90ms) and automated batching that lowers token costs. Want a quick pilot?"
Priya M: For the routing play, propose 4 paths -> trial-self-serve, SDR-touch, AE-enterprise, Security-specialist. Heuristic: mention of 'private', 'on-prem', or explicit SLA request -> AE; 'compliance' or 'audit' -> Security-specialist; >100 seats or >$X/month -> AE; otherwise SDR.
Sam T: Here's a tiny pseudo-rule we can paste in one-pager: ```
if mentions_private or asked_for_sla >= 99.9:
  route = AE_enterprise
elif mentions_compliance or asks_for_ISO:
  route = Security_specialist
elif estimated_MRR > 10000:
  route = AE_enterprise
else:
  route = SDR_first_touch
```
ops-bot: Webinar event created: "SecureServe: Secure, SLA-backed Inference" on 2026-07-14 15:00 UTC -> https://events.redwood/servelaunch (auto-reg enabled)
Elena V: Webinar run of show: 10m exec overview, 25m demo (deploy modes + routing), 15m customer case + benchmark slide, 10m ops Q&A. Keep QA heavy on security/SLAs.
Noah L: For CISO one-pager bullets: 1) Trust & control (VPC, KMS, audit logs), 2) SLAs & multi-tier routing, 3) Compliance & certifications (SOC2, ISO summary), 4) Economics: batch/caching levers and cost per 1M tokens example. Add CTAs: "Request pilot (AE)", "Schedule security review (SDR)", "Start trial".
Priya M: Field quickstart will include a compact checklist: firewall egress IPs, TLS+mutual-TLS note, sample config snippet for private deploy (port, LB, health checks), and verification steps. I'll include a minimal sample: ```
# sample healthcheck curl
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://private.example.internal/v1/infer -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
Sam T: I'll produce one benchmark slide (latency distribution + cost delta across hosted vs dedicated vs private). CSV and chart by Wed EOD. Use conservative labeling: "example workload" and note environment.
Elena V: Tone: tight, factual, low hype. Avoid absolute claims. Add UTM pattern: utm_source=mkting, utm_campaign=servelaunch_v1, utm_content={cta}.
Noah L: I'll push initial copy into /marketing/drive and tag design. Also will prepare the 90s SDR TL;DR for sales enablement.
Priya M: Routing automation note for ops: we'll provide a boolean flag 'needs_security_review' + 'requested_sla' in lead payload to map to the rules.
Sam T: Confirming numbers and a short two-sentence benchmark narrative for SDRs: "Example: on a short-chat workload SecureServe delivered P99 latency in the ~90ms range for hosted, improved to ~70ms on Dedicated with sustained throughput; batching+cache reduced token spend ~25-30% in tests. Results are illustrative."
Elena V: Great. Deadline: first drafts in the doc by Tue COB, design pass Wed, finalize by Thu AM. I'll compile and publish the launch post once design delivers. :rocket:
